تستسهلوا (form X)
# تَسْتَسْهِلُوا (tastashilū) /tas.tas.hi.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَسْهَلَ (istashala)
# تُسْتَسْهَلُوا (tustashalū) /tus.tas.ha.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَسْهَلَ (istashala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
